title: Senior NSA official blocks a finding from reaching President Bush

tellings.quote:
We were going to tell Bush
something we had discovered.
And she said, "Nope, I'm not going to
let you do that."

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, the US agency that intercepts and studies communications, says that in the 2000s his team found something they planned to tell President George W. Bush. He says a senior official above him, a woman, refused and said she would not let them do it. If true, it would show that findings can be stopped before they ever reach the president.
